title: マイルCSの後に・大団円

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha… You're a tough one, Akebono… Phew!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Your presence here today really fired me up and made me want to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's been foreeever since I ran so hard. It feels like my body's gonna fall apart!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha! It's the same for me! Thanks for the great match!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! M-me too! I felt all like, "Raaah!" and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the audience is smiling. I felt just like Carrot Ranger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Siiigh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whew, I can't move a muscle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. That looks nice. Maybe I'll lie down for a bit too. Oof!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Applause and cheers from the stands pour over them nonstop as the three of them chat.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniffle! That was such a passionate race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Right? They were all trying so hard, I couldn't look away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship, which the runners all wove together with Fuji Kiseki at the lead…

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… damn! That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Set everyone's hearts aflame!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Your cheers were what made it possible for us to run our best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, the curtain closes on our classic year. Next up is our long-awaited senior year, filled only with heavy hitters!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even bigger and better miracles await you there, so farewell until then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki bows politely toward the stands, snaps her fingers, and…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Where's the smoke coming from?! Where's Fuji Kiseki?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, she makes her graceful exit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just wondering, but how do you feel about taking on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after we return from Kyoto, Fuji Kiseki stops by my office and opens a conversation with that sudden question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a 1,200-meter G1 turf sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a little suspicious of the straightforward suggestion since she's usually such a prankster.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Could we go over the details at a later time? I'd like to gather my thoughts some more first!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right now, all I know is that I want to put on an even bigger show in my senior year than I did as a classic racer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You must've seen all the articles people have written about my trajectory during my classic year, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "It's been a year of victories for this entertainer, leaving many moved by her shows."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Although her agenda has yet to be revealed, expectations are high."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Everyone is looking forward to what the future holds." Hehe! It's kind of embarrassing to be lauded like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, almost every article out there is filled with profuse praise for her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was able to send off my classic year with a grand finale, and it went even better than I planned, to be honest!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone's looking forward to an even bigger miracle from me, and I can't disappoint them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The praise extolling Fuji Kiseki shows no signs of slowing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If anything, her charismatic speech, miraculous exit from the venue, and theatrical announcement boosted her popularity exponentially.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Countless articles and video clips about her are uploaded every day.
